name: Hitler's Escape Family Accounts AI Scraper

mentions.name: Hitler's Escape Family Accounts AI Scraper
mentions.description: This project uses AI to mass-scrape the internet for family accounts of Hitler's escape, with the goal of proving he made it to Argentina. The author began skeptical of the claim but now puts its likelihood at 60-70%.
mentions.source_excerpt: Using AI to mass scrape the internet for family accounts of Hitler's escape, to prove he made it to Argentina. I started off very skeptical but now I think its 60-70%.
mentions.author: _menelaus
